newsitem.title: UK: IPE futures chase NYMEX crude and product gains.
newsitem.headline: IPE futures chase NYMEX crude and product gains.

text.p: IPE Brent crude oil futures re-touched morning highs and made fresh gains, lifted by technical strength on NYMEX crude and fundamental gains on U.S. heating oil futures, traders said.

Jan Brent was trading 22 cents a barrel firmer at $23.75 around mid-afternoon after NYMEX crude made early technically led gains on follow-through buying from Friday when January WTI filled an 18 cent downside gap.
Traders said forecasts of colder weather in the U.S. Northeast by Thursday and below normal temperatures by the weekend had also boosted prices for crude and heating oil.
The colder weather forcasts for the U.S. boosted IPE gas oil with the Jan contract trading $6.25 firmer at $222.00 a tonne at 1550 GMT.
Independent forecaster, Weather Services Corp (WSC) said a blast of cold weather could hit the key heating oil market of the northeast United States by the weekend.

In Europe, WSC forecast above normal temperatures in northwest Europe for a period extending into the next 10 days, but in northeast Europe temperatures were seen below normal over the next five days.
